PCAM1.title: Photo 1
PCAM1.caption: Of 6 labeled large rocks, the baseline finds 3 and the blur model finds 5. Neither model raises a false alarm.

TCAM4.title: Photo 2
TCAM4.caption: Of 6 labeled large rocks, the baseline finds 3 with one false alarm. The blur model finds 4 with none.

PCAM13.title: Failure case
PCAM13.caption: Of 4 labeled large rocks, all in a cluster cut off by the top edge of the frame, the baseline finds 2 and the blur model finds only 1. The blur model's second box spans two rocks at once, so it counts as a false alarm.
